name: Monument: Archive of Black Innovation
tag: Interactive museum and patent archive that brings Black inventors into any classroom or gallery.

scenarios.title: Inventors who shaped transport
scenarios.ask: Show inventors whose work shaped modern traffic and transport, with a timeline from {start} and a {quiz}-question quiz.
steps: Search
Found inventors and patents connected to transport and road safety.
Curator
Opened a gallery on Garrett Morgan's traffic signal patent of 1923.
Timeline
Placed related patents on a timeline from {start} to today, a span of {=2026 - start} years.
Lesson
Built a {quiz}-question classroom quiz from the gallery and grouped {students} students into {=ceil(students / 5)} teams.
followups: Yes. Galleries show patent drawings and dates from public patent records, with the patent number on each page.
Can students explore on their own?
Yes. Each team gets its own path through the gallery and the quiz scores roll up for the teacher.

scenarios.title: Build a library exhibit
scenarios.ask: Create an exhibit featuring {count} inventors for our library, shown on {screens} screen(s).
steps: Curator
Chose {count} inventors, for example Lewis Latimer's 1882 carbon filament process and Marie Van Brittan Brown's 1969 home security patent.
Writer
Wrote a 90-second story card for each inventor with the patent drawing.
Display
Built a loop for {screens} screen(s), about {=round(count * 1.5 / screens, 1)} minutes per screen.
Visitor guide
Added a QR code on each card that opens the full archive page.
followups: Yes. Add your own entries with sources and they appear in the same style, marked as local additions.
Who else is in the archive?
Examples include Patricia Bath, whose 1988 patent covered a laser device for cataract surgery, and Garrett Morgan, Lewis Latimer and many more.

scenarios.title: Run a student research project
scenarios.ask: {students} students each need an inventor to research in {field} over {weeks} weeks.
steps: Matcher
Gave each of the {students} students a different inventor and primary sources such as patent drawings.
Research guide
Built a {weeks}-week checklist: background, the invention, its impact today.
Writing coach
Added sentence starters and a citation helper for each source.
Showcase
Set up a class gallery where finished projects appear side by side.
followups: What if two students want the same inventor?
The matcher can pair them on different inventions or let them work as a team.
A rubric covers sources, accuracy and presentation, and each checkpoint is timestamped.
